Paragraph: "I could not protect my Seetha when she needed me; seeing this deer fills me with shame and regret..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama experiences intense self-blame, regret, and guilt over failing to prevent Seetha's abduction.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama voices his feelings of guilt and perceived inadequacy directly to Lakshmana.
Outcome/Resolution: He confronts his painful feelings of self-reproach.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Anutapa (Deep remorse and self-reproach for perceived failure in duty)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Even the divine incarnate undergoes human feelings of regret (Anutapa) to demonstrate the depth of love and responsibility.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Survivors/protector guilt: intense self-blame and inadequacy triggered by comparing one's perceived failure to another's success.
